name: Review route → CHANGES_REQUESTED, budget exhausted → park toward the human
description:
The review-exhaustion park (design R4/D16/SB5, group 5). When Quinn requested changes (route.review.verdict='changes_requested') AND the shared attempt budget is exhausted (route.attempt.instance count ≥ B, via length_gte the PER-TASK budget), the task cannot converge — PARK toward the human with the findings. An unreviewable-to-approval task NEVER ships a PR, it parks (SB5).

TRIGGER = Quinn's review LOOP: route.review.verdict eq "changes_requested" (required:false) AND route.attempt.instance length_gte $entity.triple.route.task.budget.value (required:true — count ≥ B, where B = task.spec.budget mirrored as route.task.budget, fail-closed; #519 scalar .value + #568 length_gte) AND route.attempt.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). Mutually exclusive with the review-retry (07b, length_lt B) on the budget count. submit_review mirrors route.task.budget onto this review loop with the verdict; its absence faults the tool loudly (D7).

WRITER: run.awaiting.human — a sanctioned park realization (G5), same meaning as the others, differing only in trigger. RUN BINDING: the park marker goes on the RUN (subject-override the review loop's agent.run.entity-id).

SELF-EXTINGUISHING: route.attempt.routed on the review loop (a LOOP-scoped guard is required — the loop does not carry the run-scoped park marker).

on_enter.subject: $entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id
on_enter.object: the reviewer requested changes but the iteration budget is exhausted; see review.findings.value
